convergence_runs.name: unite_reference

phases.loop_count_limitation: World x-z nose projection proxy, not a validated 3D loop count; undersampling can miss turns.
phases.diagnostic_definition: glide_time_s/glide_start_time_s use stricter tool thresholds; stable_glide_duration_s/glide_entry_time_s retain engine diagnostic. Both threshold sets are saved, neither drives forces.

convergence_runs.energy_limitations: Rigid body translational+rotational energy only; added-fluid and elastic energy unmodelled. Ground-contact losses included. Not a closed total-energy audit.
